title: Google Translate now lets you hear real-time translations in your headphones
description: The real-time headphone translations experience keeps each speaker’s tone, emphasis, and cadence intact, so it’s easier to follow the conversation and tell who’s saying what.
author: Aisha Malik

title: ChatGPT: Everything you need to know about the AI-powered chatbot
description: A timeline of ChatGPT product updates and releases, starting with the latest, which we’ve been updating throughout the year.
author: Kate Park, Kyle Wiggers, Cody Corrall, Alyssa Stringer

title: Google launched its deepest AI research agent yet — on the same day OpenAI dropped GPT-5.2
description: For the first time, developers can embed Google's Deep Research tool, based on Gemini 3 Pro, into their own apps.
author: Julie Bort

title: 1X struck a deal to send its ‘home’ humanoids to factories and warehouses
description: Despite launching as a humanoid robot designed to help consumers around the house, 1X's Neo robots are heading to industrial use cases.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Disney hits Google with cease-and-desist claiming ‘massive’ copyright infringement
description: Disney is accusing the tech giant of unauthorized distribution of its copyrighted characters without permission via Gemini AI.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Google’s AI try-on feature for clothes now works with just a selfie
description: In the past, users had to upload a full-body picture of themselves to virtually try on a piece of clothing. Now they can use a selfie and Nano Banana will generate a full-body digital version of them.
author: Aisha Malik

title: OpenAI fires back at Google with GPT-5.2 after ‘code red’ memo
description: OpenAI just launched GPT-5.2, a frontier model aimed at developers and professionals, pushing reasoning and coding benchmarks as it races Google’s Gemini 3 while grappling with compute costs and no generator.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Google debuts ‘Disco,’ a Gemini-powered tool for making web apps from browser tabs
description: Google Labs is testing a product that will work with your browser tabs to make web apps for you.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Runway releases its first world model, adds native audio to latest video model
description: Runway debuts a physics-aware world model that simulates reality to train agents and power video, robotics, and avatar applications.
author: Ivan Mehta, Rebecca Bellan

title: Disney signs deal with OpenAI to allow Sora to generate AI videos featuring its characters
description: Disney says that alongside the agreement, it will "become a major customer of OpenAI," as it will use its APIs to build new products, tools, and experiences, including for Disney+.
author: Aisha Malik
